name: spray-diary
title: Spray diary for review
for_each: select id,code from blocks order by code

sections.title: Block
sections.sql: select code,name,crop,variety,workplace_address from blocks where id=$1

sections.title: Applications
sections.sql: select s.ref,s.product,s.applied_at,s.amount,s.unit,w.name operator,s.wind_speed_kmh,s.wind_direction,s.boundary_measures,s.whp_days,s.rei_hours,s.label_ref from sprays s join workers w on w.id=s.worker_id where s.block_id=$1 order by applied_at
sections.note: Check original labels and programme rules. Missing values are unresolved.

name: harvest-docket
title: Harvest record, review status before use
for_each: select id,ref from harvests order by ref

sections.title: Trace and destination
sections.sql: select h.ref,b.code block,b.name,b.variety,h.picked_at,h.bins,h.kg,h.destination,h.docket,h.status from harvests h join blocks b on b.id=h.block_id where h.id=$1
sections.note: A held record is not clearance to dispatch fruit.

name: labour-summary
title: Labour allocation, not payroll
for_each: select id,code from blocks order by code

sections.title: Recorded time and costs
sections.sql: select w.name worker,l.worked_on,l.activity,l.hours,l.cost from labour l join workers w on w.id=l.worker_id where l.block_id=$1 order by worked_on
sections.note: Costs are supplied allocations. No wages, tax, entitlements or payments are calculated.
